text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, that package is...♪ You 
remembered my birthday, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course! I just grabbed a bunch of 
McQueen's favorite snacks and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just half-assed like that?! How could you 
be so careless...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mm, but y'know... I tried thinking about 
it in the beginning too, but I just 
couldn't come up with anything.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Something even greater than what you 
usually give.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I train, struggle, and keep getting 
stronger all so I can run with McQueen. In 
other words—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I basically give all my days to McQueen 
anyway. Is there anything more I can even 
give?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. There is nothing more to it... 
than that. However, now that you've said 
it, please be prepared.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I never return what I've received. I will 
have you run beside me forever. No matter 
how many seasons may pass—forever.
